messages:
lena: Quick thread 1: Polaris wants a cross-validated perf/W + throughput benchmark we can cite in a marketplace listing and a partner blog. They prefer minimal dry-run on Mon, full sweep Tue. Sheet: https://tiny.redwood/polaris-bench. Who takes owner?
jordan: @lena this is Polaris PM. We can provide board telemetry (onboard INA sensors) and an external clamp meter. Embargo until Thurs 12:00 UTC. Target models: Cerulean-6B and Marlin-13B. Need perf/W, tokens/s, p95, and thermal headroom.
mario: I'll lead the harness. Plan: run fp16, int8, and two kernel branches (k11 and k11-tuned). We'll publish raw logs + scripts. Need partner SSH + sample docker image. Also confirm workload: chat-style prompts vs bulk generation?
jordan: chat-style with 8-turn prompt for seq=128 and single-shot for seq=1024. Include batching 1/8.
zara: bench automation ready. I'll create job matrix and auto-attach power/time series. Quick snippet of run config I'll use: ```benchctl run --model marlin-13b --build k11-tuned --seq 1024 --batch 8 --power-sensor external --trace perf.json --out s3://redwood-bench/polaris/214210```
ops-bot: Reservation confirmed: dedicated-pool-9 allocated Tue 06:00-20:00 PDT. Ops ticket #INF-4621.
lena: Acceptance criteria draft: cross-validated perf/W within 5% between sensors; Marlin-13B >=1.8 tokens/s/W at seq=1024 batch=8; Cerulean-6B p95 <200ms batch=1 seq=128. Kernel candidate if >6% throughput uplift with <=0.4W increase. Thoughts?
mario: Criteria sound reasonable. Add reproducibility: seed=42 and fixed prompt set v1.2. Also require single-thread baseline numbers for both models.
jordan: Polaris: we can supply a short workload replay tool to ensure identical input streams. We'll also run internal validation. We'll need a non-disclosure note for the embargo artifacts.
zara: Early run sample: 
[JOB] id=214210-1 model=cerulean-6b build=k11 batch=1 seq=128 tokens/s=9.8 power=4.9W perf/W=2.00 p95=185ms 
[KV] warm=off 
[THERM] inlet=44C cpu=65C
-- saving to s3://redwood-bench/polaris/214210/sample-log.json
lena: Great. Action items: mario push OCI tag + kernel artifacts by Mon 18:00 PDT; jordan drop partner IP/SSH + clamp-meter creds by Mon 20:00 PDT; zara will post run links and dashboards in this thread when ready. I'll prepare a short partner blog outline and datasheet template after run. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
mario: Will push images + kernels by Mon 17:30. I'll DM ops-bot for creds exchange.
jordan: We'll send creds and NDA note by Mon 19:00. Also ok on embargo until Thurs 12:00 UTC.
zara: Kicking off dry-run job now (id=214210-dry1). Will post initial telemetry in ~30m.
ops-bot: dry-run job 214210-dry1 completed. Exit=0. Uploads at s3://redwood-bench/polaris/214210/dry1/
